verdict.rationale: v0's docs explicitly claim to 'Clone pages with screenshots or Figma files' and turn mockups/wireframes into high-fidelity UIs, directly supporting the Figma-import story. However, this is only a brief marketing-style mention with no detailed workflow documentation on the Figma import process itself, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of Figma-specific fidelity or limitations. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the Figma import workflow, independent/hands-on verification of Figma-to-code fidelity, and evidence addressing complex Figma file support (auto-layout, components, etc.).
